summary: A promotional website for 'Omm Vedic Numerology' offering services like tarot card reading, numerology, vastu, and pronology. Users can book appointments, request home tours, or request name changes. All services are priced at ₹400. An admin panel is being added for the website owner to manage bookings.
architectural_notes: Services offered: Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology

existing_features.title: Create a visually rich homepage for 'Omm Vedic Numerology' that prominently displays the brand name and showcases the four core services: Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, and Pronology. Each service should have a dedicated section with a title, brief description, and a call-to-action button linking to the booking form. The page must include a hero section with a spiritual/mystical theme and a navigation bar.

Build a booking form page/section on the frontend that allows users to submit a request for any of the three categories: Appointment, Home Tour, or Name Change. The form must include fields for: service type selection, booking category selection, full name, phone number, preferred date, and an optional message. Display the price as ₹400 prominently. On successful submission, show a confirmation message.

Add a Services & Pricing section on the homepage that lists all four services with clear descriptions and a unified price of ₹400 per session. Include a brief explanation of each: Tarot Card Reading (intuitive card-based guidance), Numerology (life path and number analysis), Vastu (space energy and home alignment), and Pronology (name and sound vibration analysis).

Apply a cohesive mystical/spiritual visual theme across the entire website. Use a deep cosmic color palette (dark navy, gold, and warm amber tones), elegant serif or display typography for headings, and subtle celestial or mandala-inspired decorative elements. The layout should feel premium and trustworthy, consistent across all sections.
Generate and display a banner/hero background image and service icon illustrations for each of the four services, rendered as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated.

Add an admin panel page to the frontend accessible only after logging in with Internet Identity. After login, check the backend isAdmin function; if true, show the admin dashboard. The dashboard must display a table of all submitted bookings with columns: booking ID, service type, booking category, customer name, phone number, preferred date, message, and status. Include a login button using Internet Identity for access. If the logged-in user is not admin, show an 'Access Denied' message.

new_feature_requests.summary: Homepage promoting services: tarot card reading, numerology, vastu, pronology

Implement a backend data model for service bookings. Each booking must store: service type (Tarot Card Reading, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology), booking category (Appointment, Home Tour, Name Change), customer name, phone number, preferred date, optional message, and a status field (pending/confirmed). Expose backend functions to create a booking and retrieve all bookings.
Add admin access/panel for the website owner to manage and view bookings

Add a hardcoded admin principal to the backend. The website owner's Internet Identity principal should be stored as the designated admin. Expose a backend query `isAdmin(caller)` that returns true if the caller's principal matches the admin principal. Expose a protected `getAllBookings` query that only returns data to the admin principal and rejects all other callers.
